title: 陶瓷直接覆銅基板
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入DBC 陶瓷絕緣、銅層擴散及邊缘應力；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine dbc insulation, copper heat spreading and edge stress. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。資料表典型 k 和耐壓只適用所列測試條件；DBC、AMB 與薄膜金屬化不可視為同一製程。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Datasheet conductivity and breakdown values apply to stated conditions; DBC, AMB and thin-film metallization are distinct processes.
